ideas.why: This duplicates the known robots.txt block, and the report's wording on the fix is muddled.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute Sitemap line to robots.txt
ideas.why: This is the known missing-sitemap problem, so it is already graded.

ideas.idea: Prerender or server-render routes so content is in the HTML (item 2)
ideas.why: This duplicates the known client-only rendering problem.

ideas.idea: Give the Catalogue list its content in server HTML instead of a runtime fetch in useEffect
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs only in the browser, so the mug names are missing from the initial HTML and need build-time or server data.

ideas.idea: Set a unique title and description per route
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title in index.html, and nothing sets per-route titles, so the pages can't be told apart.

ideas.idea: Describe the mugs in text (prices, sizes, materials, shipping)
ideas.why: Home.jsx has one sentence and the Catalogue shows only names, so there is little text for machines or people to read.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own linked page
ideas.why:
Catalogue items are plain

text with no links, so individual mugs can't be reached or shared.

ideas.idea: Add Product JSON-LD for price and availability on mug pages
ideas.why: There is no structured data now, and it would apply once mug pages exist with real product details.
index.html has no viewport tag, which is true and affects mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags for share previews
ideas.why: This is accurate but is standard advice for any site and has little effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical link on your own domain
ideas.why: The report could not check this because no domain is declared, so it is standard advice with little to act on.
